card.name: Missed-dose instructions near next dose
card.fires_on: Words in missed-dose instructions that lead into 'time for the next dose', such as 'almost', 'is' and 'before' after 'unless it is'. Also fires on some dosing-interval words like 'every' and 'mg' in dose schedules.

modes.label: Missed dose, next dose near
modes.description: Words just before 'time for the next dose' in a missed-dose rule.
modes.example: If a dose is missed it should be taken as soon as possible, unless it is<< almost>> time for the next dose.

modes.label: Dosing interval wording
modes.description: Words in renal or infusion schedules that set how often a dose is given.
modes.example: Slowly inject one-half of the total daily dose over a period of 3 to 5 minutes<< every>> 12 hours.

card.writes: It pushes toward time-of-day and day-relative words like 'morning', 'overnight' and 'next day', and away from year-based words.
card.plain: It spots missed-dose advice that says to skip the dose if the next one is nearly due.
